brief:
Israeli occupation forces injured two Palestinians in Qalqilia on Wednesday evening, IMEMC News reported. The incident occurred as soldiers carried out operations in the occupied West Bank city.

Israeli forces also obstructed a Palestinian Red Crescent Society ambulance during the operation, impeding emergency medical response. The military conducted invasions across several areas of the occupied West Bank on the same day.
dek: Israeli occupation forces injured two Palestinians in Qalqilia on Wednesday evening, obstructed a Palestinian Red Crescent Society ambulance, and carried out invasions in several areas of the occupied West Bank.
title: Israeli forces injure two Palestinians in Qalqilia raid
